questions.prompt: Your test script exits 125 at some commit. What does git bisect run do?
options: Skips that commit, as if you had typed git bisect skip
Stops the bisect with an error

questions.prompt: Which exit codes does git bisect run treat as "bad"?

goals.label: Let git run the test with bisect run
Let bisect narrow the search down to one commit

checks.script: t=$(git rev-parse --git-path BISECT_TERMS); { read -r new; read -r old; } < "$t" 2>/dev/null || { new=bad; old=good; }; b=$(git rev-parse -q --verify "refs/bisect/$new") || exit 1; [ "$(git rev-list --count "$b" --not $(git for-each-ref --format='%(objectname)' "refs/bisect/$old-*"))" = 1 ]

goals.label: Identify the commit that broke fmt.sh
Know which exit codes mean bad
Finish the search with git bisect reset (no bisect in progress)
